newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range in slow trading today with demand decreasing in recent times.

"Financial instititions have borrowed less in recent weeks with no new treasury bond issue for two months now," said one trader. "State-run banks continue to lend out money, causing a surplus on the market."

Traders said they believed a slight downward trend on the market would not change in the short term and an expected cut in bank reserve ratios by the central bank later this year would help depress the rates.
